obligation_candidates.canon_label: Define a controlled coarse destination enum/family in the route contract layer.
exact_tokens: Define a controlled coarse destination enum/family in the route contract layer.
Let object identity and scope pick the thing to show; let destination pick the major surface class; let shell state handle the rest.

Recommended coarse destination classes: `primary_view` (Dashboard, Projects, Wizard, Interview, Settings, Usage, FileEditor, Orchestrator), `side_panel` (chat, files, source_control, github_actions, docker_manager, artifacts, run_debug), `bottom_panel` (terminal, problems, output, ports, browser, debug), `embedded_surface` (document_pane, agent_activity), `page_tab` (Orchestrator tabs like Progress, Seams/Tiers, Node Graph, Evidence, History, Ledger)
notes: Contracts_V0.md must define the controlled coarse destination vocabulary. The vocabulary must stay coarse — not include dock/floating realization, subview state, widget slots, remembered collapse/expand preferences.
Some current commands still mix coarse destination choice with detailed shell/subview state in one payload — this must be resolved.
